construction.first_release: Synthetic level chains compounded from official contemporaneous m/m first-release growth, truncated by each series' actual historical release date.
construction.revised: Current runtime revised levels, but truncated to the same observation months that were available at each historical checkpoint.
construction.engine_equivalence: Per-series normalizedSeriesImpulse then median across eligible Growth series; thresholds 0.20 for direction and acceleration, matching frozen v9.3 blockDynamics.
construction.checkpoint_frequency: Union of official GDP and Retail release dates.

caveat: This reconstructs the CAD Growth block only. Full CAD macro state also requires PIT Labour series and historical Rates/CB inputs.
